hosts.explanation: Some clubs stream their home games themselves. If a club is ticked here, broadcasts of its game days run as "unlisted" while the game is on and are switched to public three hours after the stream ends, then linked in the schedule. The agreement covers every game it hosts, including those in which it is not the home team.
